resources.string: Locally enabled desktop control for your paired GOSSHD Agent. Reads visible windows and screenshots and performs your requested gestures or editable text actions. Enable control in the app and pair explicitly. Stop anytime from the notification.

Android Agent (no root)
Agent: %4$s
Accessibility: %1$s
Desktop control: %2$s
Desktop control is optional. ADB/Shizuku is only needed for optional activation.
%3$s
Run the copied ADB grant first
Activation requested; other accessibility services preserved
Restore Agent / control after boot (best effort)
Old pairing token revoked; the built-in Agent is updated automatically

Install this same APK using ADB or by downloading and opening it on the phone. Enter the server address and enrollment token, then tap Save and start Agent. No Termux or persistent ADB connection is required.
For optional desktop control, enable accessibility and the desktop-control switch. Pairing with the built-in Agent is automatic. External local clients can still use the pairing token.
Enable boot recovery and adjust battery / vendor auto-start settings if desired. Force-stop and system restrictions can still stop the service. All commands run as the ordinary app user, not root or ADB shell.
Mobile data: ordinary accessibility observations omit screenshots; request them only when needed. The Agent connection and requested transfers use network data. Updates require installing a signed APK; no background binary update is downloaded.
Start Shizuku locally first. ADB mode must be restarted after reboot.
Enter the HTTPS server address and the enrollment token from its Agent installation guide. The APK includes the Agent; Termux is not required. Credentials are stored only in private app data.
Enter a valid HTTPS server address and enrollment token (HTTP is allowed only on loopback for development)
Cannot save or load the private Agent configuration
Agent binary unavailable for this device; install a supported APK
